title: Pebble Quest
description: Pebble Quest is a new custom skyblock server! Anything you can imagine you can build it here!
body:
# Pebble Quest

Pebble Quest is a custom Skyblock server built around long-term progression, island upgrades, minions, spawners, dungeons, and a player-driven economy.

The goal is simple: give players a Skyblock server that actually feels worth grinding on without wiping everyone’s progress every few weeks.

## What makes it different?

Pebble Quest is not just a default Skyblock setup with a few plugins thrown on top. A lot of the server is custom-built around the economy, islands, progression, and quality-of-life systems.

You can play casually, grind leaderboards, build a massive island, farm mobs, run dungeons, or just slowly work your way up through upgrades.

## Features

- Custom Skyblock islands
- Island levels, upgrades, members, and roles
- Minions with upgrades, modules, storage, fuel, and automation limits
- Custom spawners with upgradeable levels
- Dungeon mobs, bosses, runes, and rewards
- Player shops, selling, cash, and shared island economy
- Crates, vote rewards, and monthly island competitions
- Daily quests and progression rewards
- Java and Bedrock support
- Active balancing so the economy does not instantly fall apart

## Fair progression

Pebble Quest is designed to be a grind, but not an impossible one.
